data.name: Entropy Department
data.detailed_description:
• Step into the role of an overseer of a retro facility where science is a service, and containment is a contract. Inspired by the mood and pacing of classic late-90s sci-fi games, you’ll design and expand a research complex built to handle the jobs you accept: test hazardous materials, contain anomalies, and deliver results under pressure.

  • Your facility isn’t a backdrop, but the machine you engineer. Build labs, security, and logistics from the ground up in a physics-driven sandbox where mistakes become incidents.

  • Your staff act with intention: they assess situations, pursue objectives, and adapt their methods instead of following fixed scripts, creating surprising (and sometimes disastrous) outcomes. Keep the work flowing, their needs satisfied, and the doors sealed!

WHAT YOU ARE HIRED TO DO

  • DESIGN THE FACILITY around work and the needs of the inhabitants: labs, storage, holding areas, security layers, safe routes, cafeterias, personal chambers.

  • ACCEPT CONTRACTS for research, testing, and containment - each with different risks, requirements, and failure conditions.

  • OPERATE IN FIRST-PERSON to inspect, intervene, and improvise during live incidents.

  • USE PHYSICS in a reactive sandbox: objects move, break, block paths, and contribute to emergent failures and solutions.

  • MANAGE STAFF who act with intent. They pursue objectives, weigh priorities, and choose action sequences dynamically - leading to believable, unscripted moments.

  • FACE THE FEAR that creeps in through sound, lighting, perception, and the feeling that procedures aren’t the only thing shaping outcomes.

data.short_description: A facility-building management sim with a physics-fueled sandbox: build the labs, run the shifts, direct your goal-driven staff, and stop anomalies from turning one mistake into a collapse. How long can your facility survive its own research?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12288 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB VRAM preferred) — DirectX 12 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
